Philadelphia adds LeBron to face champion New York in NBA season opener - CHOSUNBIZ 
 2026년 10월 21일(수) Industry Finance Real Estate IT Retail Science Policy Society International Entertainment Culture Sports English Sports Philadelphia adds LeBron to face champion New York in NBA season opener 
 입력 2026.10.20. 14:20 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 The NBA, reshaped by blockbuster player moves, opens the 2026-2027 season. Exciting matchups will take place from opening day, including the showdown between Philadelphia, which added LeBron James, and defending champion New York.
 Korea Sports Leisure Co., Ltd. (CEO Kim Dae-wook), the trustee operator of Sports Toto, the sports promotion lottery issued by the Seoul Olympic Memorial Public Sports Promotion Foundation, announced on the 20th that it will sell proto win-loss betting round 124 for the three NBA season-opening games held on the 21st (all times Korea time).
 The games are Detroit Pistons vs. Boston Celtics (4 a.m.), New York Knicks vs. Philadelphia 76ers (8 a.m.), and San Antonio Spurs vs. Oklahoma City Thunder (10:30 a.m.).
 Bets can be placed on various types including moneyline and handicap, under/over, and SUM, and purchases for all three games close at 11 p.m. on the 20th. Tickets can be bought at nationwide Sports Toto outlets and the official online sales site Betman.
 The biggest feature of this season opener is the teams' changed strengths following several star transfers. How quickly the newly joined players synchronize with the existing core will determine outcomes in the opening games.
 The most talked-about game is the matchup between New York and Philadelphia. New York, which reached the top last season, will face Philadelphia, which newly acquired LeBron James and Jaylen Brown, at home in Madison Square Garden.
 With the addition of the two players, Philadelphia has built a powerful offense alongside Joel Embiid and Tyrese Maxey. If James's game management, Brown's scoring, Embiid's rim control and Maxey's quickness mesh, they could pose a significant burden to opposing defenses.
 New York will rely on the cohesion of the players who won the title together. Unlike Philadelphia, which must test a new combination, New York aims to use the solid chemistry of its existing players to seize control at home.
 Changed rosters are also a key variable in the Detroit-Boston matchup. Boston sent Brown, who had formed the team's core with Jayson Tatum, to Philadelphia and acquired Paul George. Interest centers on what offensive power the new Tatum-George pairing will display.
 Detroit will emphasize the energy of its young players around Cade Cunningham. With Cunningham's game orchestration, Jaden Ivey's drives and Jalen Duren's rim attacks, Detroit plans to target Boston's defense.
 San Antonio and Oklahoma City meet again after last season's Western Conference finals. San Antonio, which beat Oklahoma City to advance to the NBA finals then, aims for another win at home. For Oklahoma City it is a chance for revenge.
 At the center of the matchup are Victor Wembanyama and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander. The key is how Oklahoma City overcomes Wembanyama's overwhelming height and defensive range. Whether Gilgeous-Alexander's drives and midrange shots can shake San Antonio's defense is also an important factor.
 A basketball Toto win-5-lose betting round 28 for the NBA season-opening week is also on sale. This round, whose sales began on the 19th, covers a total of 14 games: 12 NBA games held from the 21st to the 22nd and two KBL games. Purchase deadlines are 10:30 a.m. on the 21st.
 Major targeted games include San Antonio vs. Oklahoma City (game 1), Miami vs. Minnesota (game 5), and LA Lakers vs. Golden State (game 11). In the KBL, Seoul Samsung vs. Busan KCC (game 2) and Ulsan Hyundai Mobis vs. Changwon LG (game 14) are included.
 The matchup between Miami and Minnesota at 8:30 a.m. on the 22nd is also intriguing. Miami acquired Giannis Antetokounmpo from Milwaukee, and Minnesota brought in LaMelo Ball from Charlotte.
 Miami will rely on Antetokounmpo's powerful drives and rim control, and Minnesota will counter with Ball's passing ability combined with Anthony Edwards's scoring. With both teams adding new core players, changes to offensive tactics mean viewers can see altered performances from opening night.
 Basketball Toto win-5-lose is a game in which bettors predict, based on final point differentials, a home team win by six or more points (win), a contest decided by five points or fewer (5), or a home team loss by six or more points (lose).
 A Korea Sports Leisure official said the NBA season opener, made richer in spectacle by the transfers of major stars, is expected to be more fun to predict which team will celebrate first than ever, and noted that because the three season-opening games included in proto win-loss betting round 124 have purchase deadlines the day before the games, buyers should pay attention to the sales schedule.
 Detailed sales schedules and the targeted games for proto win-loss betting round 124 and basketball Toto win-5-lose round 28 can be found on Betman, and game analysis materials are provided through the Toto Guide within Betman.
